status_vocabulary.verified: segment consistent AND reaches the chain's genesis row
status_vocabulary.partial: segment consistent but earlier history not covered — never labelled verified
status_vocabulary.broken: first failing row found (broken_link | hash_mismatch); rows after it are not counted
status_vocabulary.client_unknown: request failed or forbidden — no status rendered
